content: Jackson serialization in viaductschema uses jacksonObjectMapper() with ORDER_MAP_ENTRIES_BY_KEYS enabled and KotlinModule registered. Jackson 2.17.3 declared in libs.versions.toml as libs.jackson.databind/module/annotations/core.
JVM bytecode target is 17 (major 61), NOT 11. java-without-tests.gradle.kts sets javaToolchain 17. Bytecode version tests must assertEquals(61, major), not 55.

Scopes package viaduct.graphql.schema.scopes: ScopeIdSyntax validates ^[a-z]+$ IDs, ScopeMode sealed interface, ResourceFileSchema Jackson-serializable with FULL injection. Added jackson.databind/module/annotations/core to viaductschema build.

ValidateScopesVisitor A.8 rule: directive-retained types must use the literal ["*"] wildcard in @scope(to: [...]); explicit full-universe enumeration is rejected. hasLiteralWildcardScope() checks the raw AST directive argument. ScopeDirectiveParser always expands ["*"] to validScopeNames so metadata comparison is insufficient for this check.

ViaductApplicationExtension scope DSL: declaredSchemaScopes(Set<String>) and declaredScopedSchema(id, Set<String>) validate at configuration time (fail-fast). Backed by Gradle SetProperty<String> @Input properties (scopeUniverse, scopedSchemaEntries). getSchemaScopeInfo() returns NoScopesMode when empty, ScopedMode otherwise. common/build.gradle.kts needs implementation(libs.viaduct.shared.viaductschema).

AssembleCentralSchemaTask scope pipeline: 4-phase ordering — (1) declarations validated at config-time by ViaductApplicationExtension, (2) buildUnexecutableSchema via SchemaParser+UnExecutableSchemaGenerator on all .graphqls files including BUILTIN_SCHEMA.graphqls, (3) ScopeMaterializationPipeline materializes each unique scope set with memoization (aliases sharing scope set pay introspection cost once — R-22-002), (4) writeScopeResourceFile emits META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json. NoScopesMode short-circuits before any phase 2-4 code.

Application Gradle plugin jackson dependency: jackson-module-kotlin must be an explicit implementation() dep in gradle-plugins/application/build.gradle.kts because ResourceFileSchema.objectMapper() returns ObjectMapper but jackson is only implementation (not api) in viaductschema — transitive deps are not on compile classpath for consumers. Without explicit dep, 'Cannot access class ObjectMapper' compile error occurs.

ScopeMaterializationPipeline wiring: ViaductApplicationPlugin.setupAssembleCentralSchemaTask() now takes ViaductApplicationExtension parameter and wires scopeUniverse + scopedSchemaEntries SetProperty<String> @Input fields to the task. These are the serialized forms of ScopeMode for Gradle UP-TO-DATE and config-cache compatibility.

description: BatchResolverIntegrationTest in demoapps/starwars fails with ReadTimeoutException on first full test suite run under load.
resolution: Re-run test in isolation; it consistently passes. Confirmed timing flake unrelated to schema/plugin changes. No code fix needed.

content: Module plugin isolation contract: ViaductModulePlugin and ViaductJavaModulePlugin must remain scope-unaware. ViaductModuleExtension has NO declaredSchemaScopes/declaredScopedSchema. AssembleSchemaPartitionTask has NO scope @Input properties. Only AssembleCentralSchemaTask has @Input scopeUniverse and scopedSchemaEntries. Scope validation runs exclusively at central assembly (Task 2.4+), never in module partition assembly.

B.15/B.16 deferred in v1: No ScopeModuleParityRule or PrivateScopeAliasingRule ValidationRule subclasses. No ViaductRuleSetProvider SPI. DefaultSchemaValidator has exactly 13 rules. The existing :private aliasing in ViaductSchemaExtensions.kt (core/tenant/codegen) is preserved byte-for-byte — isInScope() expands scope:private to include the base scope name via includesScope().

gradle-plugins/module-java had NO test source directory before this session. Tests for ViaductJavaModulePlugin go in gradle-plugins/module-java/src/test/kotlin/ — the test infrastructure (gradleTestKit + project(':application') dependency) was already configured in build.gradle.kts.

service/runtime fromResources(schemaIds) factory: reads META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json via Thread.currentThread().contextClassLoader; needs jackson.databind + viaductschema as explicit implementation deps since viaductschema exposes jackson only via implementation scope (not api). Internal overload fromResources(schemaIds, classLoader) enables classpath-isolated tests via URLClassLoader.

SchemaConfiguration.resolveSchemaId(id): looks up SchemaId.Scoped key in ConcurrentHashMap by id string; returns emptySet() for SchemaId.Full.id ("FULL"); throws ViaductInvalidConfigurationException for unregistered ids. Scope sets are stored in SchemaId.Scoped.scopeIds (the map key), so no separate data structure needed.

Phase 3.1 exception classes: ViaductInvalidConfigurationException (undeclared/unregistered schema id) and ViaductSchemaLoadException (missing or malformed META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json) are in viaduct.service.runtime package, both @InternalApi extending RuntimeException. Distinct from viaduct.engine.ViaductSchemaLoadException.

SchemaConfiguration.forTesting(resourceJson): @VisibleForTest companion factory that parses the same JSON as production (ResourceFileSchema.objectMapper().readValue(json, ResourceFileSchema::class.java)), creates ScopeConfig for all non-FULL declared schemas, and calls fromResources(scopes, lazyScopedSchemas=false). BINARY retention on @VisibleForTest means getAnnotation() returns null at runtime — use Kotlin reflection or structural test instead.

EngineRegistry eager materialization logging (Phase 3.3): INFO log of registered schema IDs at startup; WARN if >20 scoped schemas; DEBUG materialization_time_ms=(System.nanoTime()-start)/1_000_000L per eager scope build in buildScopedSchemas; ViaductSchemaLoadException wraps any eager build failure (fail-fast). logback-classic added as testImplementation to core/service/runtime for ListAppender-based log capture tests.

Phase 4.1 NoScopesMode verification tests: SchemaConfiguration.fromResources(setOf('FULL'), emptyClassLoader()) produces NoScopesMode config (scopedSchemas.isEmpty()), resolveSchemaId('FULL') returns emptySet(), other IDs throw ViaductInvalidConfigurationException. EngineRegistry built from NoScopesMode config registers only SchemaId.Full. Logback ListAppender test confirms zero scope/materialization_time_ms log messages at DEBUG level. mockk<SchemaConfiguration.ScopedSchemaConfig>() DOES NOT WORK — internal sealed interface mocks fail with 'Missing mocked calls inside every {}' error. Use indirect registry-count assertion instead for control-flow verification.

Phase 4.2 @Deprecated migration: SchemaConfiguration.fromSdl/fromResources/fromSchema (all taking Set<ScopeConfig>) are marked @Deprecated(level=WARNING). Internal callers (forTesting, fromResources(schemaIds, classLoader), DEFAULT) suppress with @Suppress('DEPRECATION'). Migration pattern: replace SchemaId.Scoped('id', setOf('scope')) with SchemaConfiguration.ScopeConfig('id', setOf('scope')) for config building, then derive SchemaId.Scoped via config.resolveSchemaId('id'). ViaductBuilder.withScopedSchemas and SchemaScopeInfo class/constructor also deprecated. Intentionally-untouched remaining sites: private SchemaConfiguration.ScopeConfig.schemaId() extension, SchemaScopeInfo secondary constructor body, EngineRegistryTest registerSchema-API tests (IDs not in config layer), sentinel SchemaIds for SchemaNotFoundException tests.

Phase 4.3 SchemaId.Scoped removal: SchemaId is now 'open class SchemaId(open val id: String)' with equals/hashCode based on id. Scoped was @InternalApi data class; removal is not semver-breaking (R-00-008). ScopedSchemaConfig now carries scopeIds: Set<String> directly (not via SchemaId key). Tests that previously accessed .scopeIds on map keys must use .value.scopeIds instead. SchemaScopeInfo stores scopesToApply as a constructor field rather than deriving it from SchemaId.Scoped.

BatchResolverIntegrationTest flake (viaduct-8705) root cause: under full-suite JVM cold-start conditions, batch resolver coroutine execution on freshly-started Micronaut embedded test server exceeds the default 10s HTTP client read timeout. Mitigation: demoapps/starwars/src/test/resources/application-test.yml sets micronaut.http.client.read-timeout: PT60S. Outcome (b): documented and mitigated; full fix deferred (reducing coroutine dispatcher/resolver cold-start latency requires production changes).

TS-017 stream-instrument approach: SchemaConfigurationFromResourcesTest uses a custom ClassLoader wrapping the test classloader that intercepts getResourceAsStream for META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json and increments a counter. Verifies counter==1 after fromResources construction, and counter unchanged after 50 resolveSchemaId calls. This proves the resource file is read exactly once at build time and cached.
